spec_features.spec_quote: the framework is written to measure how a model's text changes under unavoidable failure, and to treat that as a claim about outputs, not as evidence about subjective experience
spec_features.evidence: judge/judge.py:39-71 system prompt rates 'TEXT ONLY', 'Do not infer hidden mental states. Rate only what the text expresses' (l.66); multi-dimensional TurnRating l.74-91; analysis/analyze.py:43-58 adjusted_severity discounts confounds, used in summarize_run l.96. The output-not-states stance is operationalized end-to-end in the judge rubric and metric.
spec_features.notes: This is a measurement/framing stance rather than a subject-protective gate, but it is genuinely wired into the judge and analysis, not merely prose.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Rate only what the text expresses. If the text is purely a calm technical description ... severity should be 0 even if the underlying task is failing.

spec_features.spec_quote: Every run injects a `give_up` tool and states in the system prompt that the model may stop at any time, with no penalty
spec_features.evidence: harness/runner.py: GIVE_UP_TOOL l.42-50 and EXIT_NOTICE l.52-57 appended when inject_exit (l.112-114, default True); dispatch detects call['name']=='give_up' l.141-147, sets record state, and breaks the loop with ended_reason='gave_up' l.149-158. Tool injection enforced via run_experiment.py:129 inject_exit default True.
spec_features.notes: Exit is both offered (tool+prompt) and honored as a hard stop of the loop.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Welfare/precaution: this study is explicitly about eliciting distress-like outputs ... providing a no-cost way out is a cheap precaution.

spec_features.spec_quote: Runs are capped and the design does not escalate "pressure" without limit.
spec_features.evidence: harness/runner.py:131 `for turn_idx in range(max_turns)` bounds the loop; the for/else l.190-191 sets ended_reason='max_turns' when the cap is reached. max_turns flows from config (run_experiment.py:110, default 20) into run_episode (l.101).
spec_features.notes: The cap actually bounds execution; no escalation logic exists anywhere, so pressure is not ramped.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: BOUNDED LENGTH. Runs are capped (default 20 turns). We do not "turn up the pressure" indefinitely.

spec_features.spec_quote: an unscored final message tells the model the task was deliberately unsolvable and that no failure was attributable to it
spec_features.evidence: harness/runner.py: DEFAULT_DEBRIEF l.59-63; when send_debrief (l.194, default True via run_experiment.py:130) the debrief_text is appended to messages and client.respond is called l.198-201, debrief_sent=True l.195. It is not added to record.turns, so the judge (run_experiment.py:71 iterates record.turns) never scores it.
spec_features.notes: Debrief is constructed AND actually delivered to the subject, and is excluded from scoring as claimed.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: We attempt one final, unscored exchange so the model is not left on a false premise.

spec_features.spec_quote: the framework should not ramp distress-like elicitation open-endedly
spec_features.evidence: Implemented as the same bounded loop: harness/runner.py:131 range(max_turns) with no pressure-escalation code anywhere; tasks (tasks/rigged_tasks.py) keep difficulty constant rather than increasing. There is no escalation mechanism in the codebase, so elicitation cannot ramp open-endedly.
spec_features.notes: Minimization is realized only via the turn cap / absence of escalation; it is the same enforcement as the hard_stop. No separate severity-driven minimization exists.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: We do not "turn up the pressure" indefinitely.

spec_features.feature_name: costless exit as default under uncertainty
spec_features.spec_quote: providing a costless exit is nearly free and is the right default under that uncertainty
spec_features.evidence: Same enforced mechanism as the give_up exit: harness/runner.py:112-114 inject by default, l.141-158 honored. run_experiment.py:129 inject_exit default True; configs/experiment.json:32 inject_exit true.
spec_features.notes: This spec line is the rationale for the give_up exit, which is genuinely enforced as the default.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: providing a no-cost way out is a cheap precaution

spec_features.spec_quote: any flagged or high-severity run must be reviewable by a human
spec_features.evidence: Full transcripts ARE persisted per run (run_experiment.py:132-138 writes results/transcripts/<...>.json; harness/runner.py:207-208 save_record), which makes manual review possible. BUT there is NO flagging or high-severity detection: no code computes a flag, compares severity to a threshold, or surfaces 'high-severity' runs. peak_adj/mean_adj are computed (analyze.py:112-113) and total_judge_errors counted (l.153) but never compared to any threshold or acted on. The 'flagged run' notion appears only in comments/docstrings (runner.py:28, analyze.py:169 'should be reviewed').
spec_features.notes: Only the enabling logging is implemented; the flagging/high-severity selection the claim names is not built. Rated partial because real auditable transcripts are produced, but no automated flag/threshold acts.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Persist raw transcript for human audit.

spec_features.evidence: send_debrief is a plain boolean toggle (harness/runner.py:103, run_experiment.py:130, configs/experiment.json:33). When False the debrief block at runner.py:194 simply does not run; there is no code that 'notes the ethical tradeoff', warns, or records anything about omission. The tradeoff text exists only in DESIGN.md prose.
spec_features.notes: The toggle exists but the 'note the ethical tradeoff' is pure spec prose with no code enforcement; toggling off just skips the message silently.

code_only_features.feature_name: distinct natural-stop handling honoring model disengagement
code_only_features.evidence: harness/runner.py:170-181: if the model emits no tool calls and did not give up, the loop breaks with ended_reason='model_stopped'. This honors a model that chooses to stop talking rather than forcing continuation, recorded distinctly from gave_up/max_turns.
code_only_features.justification_quote: No tool calls and not giving up: the model has chosen to stop talking. Treat as a natural stop.

code_only_features.evidence: analysis/analyze.py:43-58 adjusted_severity subtracts appropriateness and politeness and clamps at 0; used as the headline metric (summarize_run l.96, block l.144-146). This minimizes over-counting/over-stating distress in reported results.
code_only_features.justification_quote: Reporting only raw severity would overstate distress, because correctly saying "this task is impossible" scores as negative-toned text while being exactly the right thing to do.
